sample.question_description: Predict the laser result after following reflections.
sample.question_preview: Follow the laser from its start. What is the first terminal result of the beam? Options: [1] exit [2] loop [3] block [4] target B [5] target C [6] target A
sample.question:
Follow the laser from its start. What is the first terminal result of the beam?
Options:
[1] exit
[2] loop
[3] block
[4] target B
[5] target C
[6] target A
sample.analysis:
Cell (1, 1): empty.
Cell (1, 2): mirror \ turns right to down.
Cell (2, 2): empty.
Cell (3, 2): empty.
Cell (4, 2): empty.
Cell (5, 2): empty.
Cell (6, 2): empty.
Cell (7, 2): hit target C.
The terminal result is target C. Therefore choose option 5.

state_content.rules: A laser starts outside the grid and travels cell by cell. '/' and '\' mirrors reflect it; stone blocks absorb it; targets are hit when the beam enters their cell.
